decisions.rationale: Fix verified: the step 3 teaching now states 'Closing a statement also closes its current ResultSet, if one exists.' (artifact.html line 319, mirrored in artifact.md), which is the fact the apply retry B (reveal and why texts) assesses, so the retry no longer tests an untaught fact.

Fix verified: the overstated sentence is gone (no 'on the server until closed' remains in html or md). Step 3 now says the Connection holds a server session, while PreparedStatement and ResultSet hold driver memory (pgJDBC reads the whole result client-side by default) and server resources only in some cases such as server-prepared statements or cursor fetching, consistent with the cited pgJDBC 'Getting results based on a cursor' section. The reverse close-order teaching is unchanged.
